name: Nico Parker
biography: Nico Parker (born 9 December 2004) is a British actress. A daughter of actress Thandiwe Newton and filmmaker Ol Parker, she made her film debut with a leading role in the fantasy film Dumbo (2019). She played Sarah Miller in the first season of the HBO series The Last of Us (2023).
